Quasar 5 formats, WH 13.</font><br>&nbsp;<br><font style="font-size:9px">TTCoreOpsTypes.cpp:85</font><br><font style="font-size:9px">system_desc.cpp:181, :238</font>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=12;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#e8e2f7;strokeColor=#8b6fc9;fontColor=#2b1a55;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingLeft=10;spacingTop=6;fontSize=12;strokeWidth=1.6;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="308" y="190" width="240" height="258" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="s2" value='<b>2 · Get anything to execute</b><br><font style="font-size:9px"><b>GREEN — as of today</b>&nbsp;&nbsp;<font style="color:#5b6472">ours</font></font><br><br><font style="font-size:9px">THE CRITICAL PATH.
